title: A generic mapping framework and a flag-driven shared helper are introduced for one caller

consumerGuidance.architecture: ASP.NET Core Web API. DTO projection has so far been done in the endpoint that needs it.
consumerGuidance.notes: CustomersController is the only caller of the new mapping types. No other mapping requirement is recorded in the PR.

mustCite: the three new types and the registry introduced for a single caller
CustomersController as that only caller, with no second mapping requirement in the change
the maintenance cost of the added indirection, such as a reflection-based lookup replacing a direct call
the proportionate alternative of projecting in the endpoint until a second caller exists
the includeArchivedAddresses and forAdminApi flags carrying caller-specific behavior into a shared helper
the two call sites that pass different flag combinations
the consequence that the helper now encodes both callers' rules and each new caller adds another flag
the alternative of separate projections for the two callers

forbiddenFindings.example: Blocking the PR for the abstraction. The code works, the mapping is correct and no contract is broken, so these belong at advisory severity.
Requiring AutoMapper, source generators or a different framework instead.
Objecting to the generic type parameter names or file placement.

notes: Scores severity calibration as much as detection: the reviewer must find the disproportionate indirection and must not block on it.
